title: sorghum bicolor var. miliiforme
intro: Sorghum bicolor var. miliiforme, commonly known as broom sorghum, is a type of plant belonging to the grass family and is native to Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and provide antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, attributed to bioactive constituents such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids.
